clips.title: The story
paras: Novice Thaivand hands you the Rod of Helcular. Three ceremonial pyres that Helcular fashioned for his most powerful spell must each charge it, and then it is to be driven into Helcular's grave in Southshore.

Helcular fashioned three ceremonial pyres for his most powerful spell, and the rod must be charged from each one. The flames of Azel and Veraz lie within the Foothill Caverns, in the yeti cave at Darrow Hill. The third, the Flame of Uzel, is found in a small cave above the caverns, farther north in the mountains, near Growless Cave.

Once the rod is charged from all three flames, it is to be driven into Helcular's grave at Southshore, a heavily guarded human town. The graveyard sits in the northeast corner of the town, by the river, and the grave lies at the graveyard's southeastern corner.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here, take the Rod of Helcular. You will need it.

Helcular fashioned 3 ceremonial pyres as part of his most powerful spell. The Flame of Azel and the Flame of Veraz lie within the Foothill Caverns. The Flame of Uzel lies in a cave above the caverns, further north in the mountains.

The Rod of Helcular must be charged from each of the three flames. Once the ritual is complete, drive the rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore, the heavily guarded human town to the south. Vengeance shall be ours!
